name: Bodyweight Standing Row
steps: Stand facing the sturdy vertical edge of a doorway or wall opening and grasp it with both hands at chest height.
Walk your feet close to the edge, lean back onto straight arms, and brace your core into an angled straight line.
Pull your chest smoothly toward your hands by driving your elbows behind you and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend both elbows slowly to lean back to the starting position under control.
tips: Keep your torso and legs aligned in a rigid plank without letting your hips sag.
Confirm the frame or support edge is completely sturdy before leaning your full weight back.
